plan: Define CheckInConsole class with __init__ storing appointments copy, session initial state, and optional source/sink.
Implement handle(action) validating action type and session state, returning error screens for invalid actions without mutating session.
Implement helper methods for prompt determination, choices generation, and screen construction.
Implement run_once() requiring source and sink, reading action, handling, displaying, and returning screen.
Ensure all screens have exactly prompt, messages, choices keys and follow contract.
mechanisms: Session state dictionary with active, contact_confirmed, appointment_id, completed.
Action type dispatch via if/elif chain.
Prompt selection based on session state and last action.
Choices list built from appointments when prompt is 'Choose appointment'.
Error handling by returning screen with first message starting 'Error:' and no state change.
